moments.text: Infrared view of an even grey background with a blue crosshair and corner brackets; from about 1 s a small black box covers the crosshair.
A small dark speck enters from the bottom edge and rises up and right toward the crosshair, fading from view below it.
A lighter rectangle flickers around the crosshair; then the small black box slides down off the crosshair and vanishes at 11.4 s.
Dark cloud patches drift in from the upper left while a tiny dark speck hovers just right of the crosshair.
The picture blacks out and flashes white for half a second; then the brackets close in and the tiny speck keeps circling the crosshair.
A dark curved edge of the recording platform creeps in from the right; by 54 s the left half is glaring white and the right half dark.

notes: Official text says the area of contrast enters from the bottom at 00:06; on this file it enters at 5.5 s. A small black redaction box sits on the crosshair 1-11 s and moves down before vanishing.
